host.cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 5850U with Radeon Graphics

purpose: Verification record for the fixes applied after the code review of the uncommitted GBA-105/GBA-110 work. Supersedes the margin classification numbers and test counts in gba105-widescreen-linux-x86_64.json.

fixes.finding: objwin_line written at output column (ppu.rs render_objects) but read at hardware column (window_mask): off by view.left, breaking INV-2 and WS-69-04 for OBJ-window lines
Effect::Reset rebuilt Gba with View::NONE while the texture stayed wide, so present_inner's frame-size assert panicked
fixes.fix: reset re-applies the presented width via apply_view; apply only retargets the guest when the texture accepted the new width, so texture and guest can never diverge
fixes.regression_test: none automated; verified by the SDL dummy smokes below plus the invariant in present_inner (see not_verified)

fixes.finding: startup apply/apply_view re-applied the raw preference unclamped, making --view-width a no-op in the windowed path and dropping the profile ceiling after zero frames
fixes.fix: all call sites resolve the width through settings::effective_view_width(preference, ceiling, session_override) and apply the resolved value to both texture and guest; an explicit edit of the width row supersedes the session override (Command::Apply carries the flag)

fixes.finding: SPEC-070 A-70-02 contradicted the normative precedence formula (min(preference, ceiling)); gba-native-rt passed a profile ceiling as a session override
fixes.fix: SPEC-070: A-70-02 now states preference >= 288, new A-70-12 pins the default-preference case, and a headless-runner clause defines override || ceiling || 240 for runners without a preference source; gba-native-rt windowed passes only the real override and labels EXPERIMENTAL only actual overrides

fixes.finding: margin classification: negative hw cast to usize marked every left-margin column Ring; wrapped affine margins could never be Ring; forced blank left stale margin_kinds
fixes.fix: structural rule per DIAG-70-02 as amended: Ring iff the sampled map position is reachable in the native row (text: wrapped map column < 240 and mosaicked-aligned; affine: sampled texel equals a native-row sample, exact membership); forced blank rebuilds margin_kinds as Backdrop

fixes.finding: gba-profile: `#` inside quoted strings was stripped as a comment (SPEC-070's own example was unparseable); RomPatch::end could overflow and offset truncated u64 to usize; apply_patches did not re-check equal lengths and could panic
fixes.fix: quote-aware strip_comment; checked_add end() returning Option with OutOfRange; usize::try_from at parse; PatchError::Length in apply_patches

fixes.finding: compile break: crates/gba-settings/src/main.rs called settings::view_ceiling with 1 argument after the 2-argument signature landed; gba-settings did not build
fixes.fix: the process has no ROM, so the call is gone and the hint text states the real rule (effective = min(preference, per-game ceiling), 240 without a profile)

t20_frame_hash_differential_rerun.note: same baseline hash as the pre-fix run (7ca201145fd0213f), so the fixes moved neither canonical pixels nor guest execution

margin_report_corrected.supersedes: the left margin in gba105-widescreen-linux-x86_64.json (ring=40, authored=0), which the negative-hw classification bug produced; both sides are now symmetric: map columns 216..239 repeat the native row (ring), map columns 240..255 are the map's hidden tail (authored)
margin_report_corrected.note: the tail columns are authored by position, not new world: they are the same 256-wide map's last 16 columns

precedence_matrix.semantics: preference is a user-side cap: effective = override || min(preference, ceiling) || 240 (SPEC-070 as amended; A-70-12)
precedence_matrix.profile_fixture: GBA_PROFILE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/profiles with a draft profile for the rkanoid SHA declaring view_ceiling = 320; the run logged `profile rkanoid-ceiling-test declares a presentation ceiling of 320 px`

smokes.desktop_dummy: SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy gba-desktop --rom games/rkanoid-v3.00.gba --frames 60 --no-splash --view-width {240,320,384}: frames=60 presented=60 audio=on underruns=0 overruns=0

hygiene.clippy: 6 warnings, all pre-existing constructs (loop-index style in ppu.rs/app.rs, enum size in Effect/Command, collapsible if in the pre-existing apply_view shape); the one warning this work introduced (redundant closure in settings.rs effective_view_width) was fixed
hygiene.fmt: touched files clean; cargo fmt --all --check still fails only in crates/gba-recomp/src/platform/{android,web,windows}.rs, same as HEAD

not_verified: the reset path (R2) with a wide surface is exercised by no automated test: driving the in-window menu requires input injection the SDL dummy run cannot do; the fix is code-level plus the texture/guest lockstep invariant
the supersede-on-edit path inside a live window (menu tests cover the model; the run_app wiring is covered only through the precedence matrix)
visual inspection of any widened window, margins and touch alignment
Web/iOS/Android presentation of the wide surface
the widened AOT package end-to-end (gba-native-rt --view-width parsed and smoke-built, not run with a real AOT package)
